name: OmniDocBench
description: 1,651 pages across academic papers, slides, books, textbooks, exam papers, notes, magazines, reports, newspapers and historical documents; text, reading order, tables (HTML/LaTeX), formulas; attributes such as fuzzy_scan and watermark.

licence.name: Research purposes only, not for commercial use (copyright statement on the dataset card)

use_reason: Research-only, non-commercial: may never ship (O4). Approved for evaluation only (owner, O4 amendment, 23 Nov 2026): never trained on, never redistributed, nothing committed except IDs and numbers, results reported separately from O4-clear data, dropped if IRIS becomes commercial.
download_status_here: not downloaded here: host not reachable from the sandbox (huggingface.co)
notes: Best match for books, slides (screenshot-like) and reading order, but non-commercial.
English pages only (page_attribute.language == english). Category map in pack.category_map; 'note' pages (handwritten notes) are left out (O1: print only).
Pinned to commit aa1ee96d106dbe53d0ae59474d75c6e6d9b53fec; OmniDocBench.json sha256 from the Hugging Face LFS pointer (read 23 Nov 2026).
Tables are scored wherever a page has them (TEDS), so there is no separate tables category for this dataset.

pack.page_addressing: page ID = page_info.image_path in OmniDocBench.json; image = images/<image_path> fetched one file at a time

estimate.how: OmniDocBench.json (42.2 MB) + up to 225 page images (~0.85 MB each)
